title: Epiphany Model Atlas
purpose: Proves an Epiphany-owned entanglement projection can publish one attention-first Eve surface for GUI and TUI lowering without moving modeled truth into a renderer.
exitCriteria: Move live projection state and authored product scenarios to EpiphanyAgent; Eve retains only the minimal cross-runtime contract witness while this boundary is incubating.
asserts: attention list is the default view
GUI and TUI consume one surface id
selection and filter commands are presentation-only
no dashboard compatibility state or renderer-owned domain truth
